name: The Girl and The Fallen Star
source:
An atmospheric visual novel about a girl's journey to find a fallen star. Along the way she meets creatures who know something about it. Some advise her to take it, others to leave it. Ultimately, she must decide for her own.

[From [url=https://dtsykunov.itch.io/fallen-star]itch.io[/url]]
